description: Active simple product on the store with a price above zero (optionally below maxPrice, in or not in a given category) and enough inventory to add to cart. KB: Product Types. Variant children of configurable products are excluded.

quantityUsed.description: Quantity the test adds to cart

maxPrice.description: Optional upper bound (exclusive) on the unit price, e.g. so a cart stays under a promotion's minimum order; left out = any price above zero

inCategoryId.description: Optional: the product must be in this category (e.g. @product.categoryId: same category as another need). Same id kind as promotion_categories.categoryId

notInCategoryId.description: Optional: the product must be in NO category with this id (e.g. @product.categoryId), so a category discount stays off it. Same id kind as promotion_categories.categoryId
